parties.petitioner: Indian Council Of Social Science Research (ICSSR)

summary: Control over grant-giving institution vs recipient autonomy; 'deep and pervasive' control doctrine; grant-withholding as punitive measure for non-compliance with Grant-in-Aid Rules; fake degrees, irregular promotions, financial mismanagement; High Court mandate for salary release upheld; final sanction for salary disbursement from deposited funds.
final_judgment: Appeals dismissed; High Court judgment affirmed; deposited amount directed for employee salaries.
